headline: Typhoon forces precautionary shutdown of advanced packaging lines in southern Taiwan; operators expect 2-3 weeks to requalify tools.
Export licence review delays shipments of high-speed optical modules from several Chinese manufacturers.
Korean memory maker reports yield excursion on its newest HBM stack; customers told to expect allocation cuts for one quarter.
Utility warns lead times for large power transformers in ERCOT have stretched beyond 18 months.
Coffee chain opens 40 new stores across the Pacific Northwest.
Mexican rack integrator completes expansion, adding a second liquid-cooled assembly line.
